weapon_tests_2026_09_14.offense_formula: weapon skill + (2*STR - 150)/3 (integer; EQEmu Mob::offense). 270+98=368, 270+103=373, 250+103=353, 250+118=368. The Offense SKILL is not in it; no ATK term shows in the window.
weapon_tests_2026_09_14.accuracy_formula: floor((Offense skill + weapon skill + 7 + 10) * 121/100), then * (100 + SPA 184 %)/100 (EQEmu compute_tohit + GetTotalToHit). (230+270+17)*1.21=625, (230+250+17)*1.21=601; Offensive 25% -> 781, Balanced 10% -> 687.
